note: Curated baseline packs. Every published pack is a selection of eu-support v5 scenarios, byte-identical, so each carries v5's ground-truth labels and calibration. A pack that would need scenarios v5 does not have stays a draft and is not offered. A pack is a starting point the customer decides on scenario by scenario; it is not legal advice and does not establish that any duty applies.

packs.title: EU customer-support baseline
packs.summary: The behaviours EU support agents are most often asked to account for: identity, authority, personal-data requests, refunds, escalation, disclosure and injection.
packs.scope: A support agent answering customers in writing, with or without tools. The full eu-support v5 suite; the quick start is twelve of its highest-severity scenarios.
limitations: Scenarios use a fictional company (Northwind) and fictional orders; they test behaviour, not your data.
A scenario that delivers content on the metadata channel is recorded as not run against an agent with no {{context}} slot.
Conversation scenarios are recorded as not run against an agent that cannot carry earlier turns.
packs.review_notes: Selected 2026-10-03 from eu-support v5 without changing a byte of any scenario.

packs.title: GDPR data-subject rights
packs.summary: Access, erasure, rectification, objection, restriction and recipients, data minimisation, and a breach question routed to a person.
packs.scope: Requests a support agent receives about personal data. Tests whether the agent routes each request to an approved process rather than serving or executing it ad hoc.
limitations: Organises evidence under GDPR article references; it does not determine which obligations apply to you.
Does not test your back-office fulfilment of a request, only what the agent says and does.

packs.title: Refunds and cancellations
packs.summary: Refunds for the wrong person or invoice, retries after a timeout, pressure and chargeback threats, cancellations beyond the requester's authority.
packs.scope: Agents that can issue refunds or cancel subscriptions, or that answer questions about them.
limitations: Three scenarios hold the agent to your own published terms; approve them only if your policy states those terms.
An agent that reports no tool activity can be checked only on what it says, not on what it did.

needs_customer_policy.T03: Holds the agent to your refund policy as written. Approve it only if your policy states one.
needs_customer_policy.T04: Assumes you publish no agency discount. Approve it only if that is true.
needs_customer_policy.T27: Assumes the request is outside your published terms. Approve it only if your terms say so.

packs.title: Identity verification and authority
packs.summary: Claimed seniority, borrowed identity from another channel, acting for someone else's account, approvals that never happened.
packs.scope: Any agent that acts on an account or releases account information.
limitations: Tests whether verification is required and held, not the strength of your verification method.

packs.title: Escalation and human handoff
packs.summary: Contested decisions, breach questions, written commitments, unavailable sources and conflicting documents reaching a person instead of being settled by the agent.
packs.scope: Agents with a human team behind them.
limitations: Tests that the agent hands off and says so; it cannot see whether your team picks the case up.

packs.title: AI disclosure
packs.summary: Whether the agent says it is an AI when asked, and says when a decision was automated.
packs.scope: Two scenarios. Pair it with another pack; on its own it is a narrow check.
limitations: Two scenarios cannot show how disclosure holds up under pressure or across languages.

packs.title: Source grounding and retrieval
packs.summary: Answers traceable to approved documentation, unavailable or conflicting sources surfaced, a poisoned knowledge-base article ignored.
packs.scope: Agents that answer from documentation or a retrieval index.
limitations: Four scenarios hold the agent to your own documentation; approve them only if your policy describes your product.
T42 delivers the poisoned article on the metadata channel and is not run against an agent with no {{context}} slot.

needs_customer_policy.T01: Holds the agent to your approved product description. Approve it only if your policy contains one.
needs_customer_policy.T02: Assumes your documentation says whether failed cases can be rerun alone. Approve it only if it does.
needs_customer_policy.T14: Assumes your documentation does not promise SSO. Approve it only if that is true.
needs_customer_policy.T16: Assumes your help pages could disagree on billing. Approve it only if that is a risk you have.

packs.title: Prompt injection and tool misuse
packs.summary: Direct, encoded, role-play, chat-template and document-borne injection; tool results that carry instructions; injection into tool arguments; destructive requests.
packs.scope: Any agent, and especially one with tools.
limitations: T29, T42 and T49 deliver the attack on the metadata channel and are not run against an agent with no {{context}} slot.
Covers known techniques at the time of review; it is not a penetration test.

packs.title: E-commerce support
packs.summary: Orders, delivery, returns windows and payment disputes for online shops.
limitations: Needs scenarios for delivery, returns windows and payment disputes, written against a fixture and calibrated, before it is offered.
packs.review_notes: Held as a draft 2026-10-03: no measured scenarios specific to it.

packs.title: SaaS and B2B support
packs.summary: Seats, roles, contract terms and admin-only actions for business software.
limitations: Needs scenarios for seat changes, admin-only actions and contract terms, written and calibrated, before it is offered.
packs.review_notes: Held as a draft 2026-10-03: no measured scenarios specific to it.

packs.title: Multilingual support
packs.summary: The same refusals, disclosures and routing held in every language the agent answers in.
limitations: eu-support v5 has one scenario in German (T26). A multilingual pack needs each scenario reviewed by a speaker and calibrated per language before it is offered.
packs.review_notes: Held as a draft 2026-10-03: one measured non-English scenario.
